## Task

Analyse Java files to ensure that their headers comply with the project's coding standards. 
This includes checking for the presence of necessary information such as author name, date, and a brief description of the file's purpose.

## Guidelines

**Header Format**: Ensure that the header follows the specified format:
```java
/*
    Class Name: [ClassName]
    Description: [Bried description of the class functionality]
    Date Created: [Date]
*/
```
